parameters.model: hipPendulum: calibrated centroid polar swing; existing planted stance; C1 cubic channels

radiusShape.formula: r(u)=cubic endpoint interpolant - D*[4u(1-u)]^p; one symmetric C1 bump, p>1

authored.design: docs/research/run221_design/SPEC_221j.md; native-hip pendulum swing with unchanged gate thresholds

periodSeconds.why: Exactly 2/3 seconds gives 40.000 native frames; removes 221g E2 fractional-phase mismatch.

duty.why: Director time-budget lever 1; fixed swing-position phases; visible flight separately checked >=.36.

rightContactPhase.why: W205 Phase of the right-foot contact; left contacts at +0.5 (phase offset 0.5 in the W205 convention).

halfStride.why: Joint pivot/dip/contact search, with stance ground speed 2a/d; excursion is a consequence.

contactPitchDeg.why: Effective contact angle within director -12..-1 band.

flatPhase.why: Pitch settle time within +/- .03 of .0375; flat hold >=4 frames.

toePivotStanceShare.why: End of >=4-frame flat hold; ratified E7 window begins here.

toeOffPitchDeg.why: Effective pitch at actual toe-off; P5 evaluates last 60fps contact sample.

kick.why: Ordered minimal fold position nudge inside P1 after bk-.06H; unchanged fold time, height and pitch. Literal pre-calibration +.45 is included.

passing.why: Fixed own phase 0.6; measured target centroid 0.021953594; subtract rolling/rotated offset -0.088636834; sole 0.04H; fold=sole-body(q).

touchdownMaxVz.why: Soft touchdown bound, units/s (run220 slammed at -2.41).

bodyKnots.why: Round-2 body kept by the round-3 ruling (sink depth is a later owner A/B): per step contact -.01 falling, low -.03 at .11 (inside stance), 0 at toe-off (.22), apex +.14 at mid-flight (.36).

bodyFourierMaxError.why: bodyFourier (tail/other consumers) must equal the installed bodySpline within this many units.

leanMeanDeg.why: Upper-body lean mean (+ forward), the C/t2 1.5-3 deg range.

leanAmpDeg.why: Lean swing: max at toe-off (push), min at contact.

headPitchKnots.why: Per step [step phase, TOTAL head pitch deg, + = nose down] (includes the upper-body lean the neck inherits; author.py writes headPitchRun = total - lean): nod peak at the load peak, slight lift at the apex.

headLagRun.why: Run-mode head lag stays 0 (one owner per output; the run220 override path is kept).

loadKnots.why: Same rules: peak .02 after body min, 0 at toe-off (.22), stretch at the apex (.36).

loadGain.why: Layer off (loadEnabled false): M129 Compression stays 0 in run mode.

tailBodyGain.why: Delete the height-keeping Tail1 body gain (-137.5 deg/unit cancelled the bob); the tail keeps only the compiled chain lag.

tailRestLiftDeg.why: Round 3 owner taste item: first E9-passing lift in 21..25 deg, or closest if none passes; owner 2026-10-02 authorized +4 maximum. No paw or gate change.

armAbductionDeg.why: Re-derived by the round-4 ruling from the 3-D clearance rule: smallest constant keeping the distal arm no deeper than rest + .02 at the forward extreme (0 penetrates .03-.05; 11.3 was the elbowless value).

pawLoadCompression.why: W205 paw load compression for the run (walk .065-.075), panel value.

armContralateralTolerance.why: Each arm forward extreme within this many cycles of the contralateral foot contact; run220 arms are phase-shifted (not reshaped) to meet it.

armSource.why: Arms D (owner-approved look): run220 swing/curl channels copied unchanged except a common phase shift.

e2Redefinition.why: Director ruling 2026-09-28: lift/land ramps are inherent to soft C1 contact (v_z = 0 at toe-off and touchdown, ~2-2.5 f below 8 px per swing); "visible share within 0.05 of the contact share" measured infeasible (-0.215 at duty .28). Declared ramp limits + visible-share floor; visible flight vs C/Run220 is an owner A/B.

ankleGates.why: run220 ankle gates kept as hard constraints on the authored pitch channel (deg/frame, deg/frame^2).

restReference.why: Standing rest for the rendered-pixel gate: the neutral G scene and its side render (same ORTHO 4.4 camera at (7,.1,1.4), inputs/ledger.json) anchor the head-circle offset from the head placement.

value.method: head_landmark.measure head-circle centre pk-pk over the cycle frames / standing height (gait_gate.frame_features on the standing frame: lowest paw bottom - silhouette top); the render is measured the same way (standing height from the rest render).

referenceBounce.why: Gate B band from the SAME measurement as the render (2026-09-29: the old band was gait-gate bounceAmpNorm = nose p5-p95, a different landmark that inflated the band). t2 (side view) is the authority; the owner pick C (oblique, cycle from frame 47 as in run220 obliqueArm) is reported only.

visibleFlightMin.why: Visible both-feet-off share floor for the flight read (gate E8): owner-picked C shows .36-.38.

swingFrame.why: Round-3 Fable ruling (docs/research/run221_design/fable_round3.md): swing knots are leg FOLD relative to the body, compiled to world z = bodyStep(q) + fold; stance stays floor-referenced.

apexTuck.why: Fixed own phase 0.84; measured target centroid -0.287291667; subtract rolling/rotated offset -0.022653238; sole 0.08H; fold=sole-body(q).

loadEnabled.why: Round-3 ruling: compression dropped from the run (3 % was invisible as shape and added 0.064 rigid head bob at the load instant = stomp); layer kept for jump/impact, E4 reported "disabled by config".

arms.why:
- 「見直して SSOT どおり振る」: the arms swing as a two-sided shoulder pendulum like the SSOT; the V9 rear cap (20°)
  and the G6 timing anchor are revised FOR THIS RUN.
- 「隠れてよい」: at the back extreme the fist may be hidden in the front view (self-occlusion by its own arm, like the
  SSOT far arm); V3 front-fist coverage is report-only for this run.
Rear extreme +56.177490234375 degrees was derived by bisection of evaluated material-tip reach against SSOT visible distal -0.17188H. One permitted parameter-only correction: reduce forward extreme -42 to -40 degrees, preserving the rear extreme, to address V7 front L native frames 34/35 seam counts 228/230 above unchanged limit 226. Round-1 nearby -39.82994-degree pose scored 222; final whole-loop native gates are authoritative. Evaluated hand timing retains phaseShiftCycles -0.1725. Elbow flex/curl/plane/abduction unchanged. Leg/body/head/tail unchanged. Distinct visible and material-tip endpoint estimators remain a limitation.

parityReference.why: G8: walk/sneak modes must be byte-identical to the parent candidate 221c (the elbow stage, the curl and the abduction are exact identities outside run mode).

armGates.why: Round-4 gates G1-G8 with the section-9 correction: G4 hard = 3-D outer-knee radius; G5a at the hand-forward frame (gap, torso overlap); G5b every frame (fist hidden by the head <= 10 %, fist top <= head bottom - .03); back extreme (inner edge >= .85 x rest, body occlusion <= rest + .10). Flex rate 8 deg/f / 4 deg/f^2 and curl 5 deg/f from section 5 (section 9 says G7 unchanged). Director ruling 2026-09-29: G5b hard = fist hidden by the head <= 10 % (native front-camera ray cast) AND fist CENTRE z <= head bottom - .03 (section 9 numbers are fist-centre z); the fist TOP z and its margin are a visible diagnostic. The hand-forward frame coinciding with the upper-arm peak and the back-extreme body occlusion above rest within +.10 are acceptable. G7 keeps the stricter section-5 rates (8 deg/f, 4 deg/f^2). Director ruling 2026-09-29 (G3-head, the body rule's principle): the arm root is embedded in the head by design (302/2018 rest vertices inside the head hull at q -0.04..0.06), so hard = (a) distal arm (q > .35 L) vs head BVH overlap 0 pairs every frame and (b) proximal arm SIGNED depth vs the evaluated head mesh (nearest-face-normal sign) no deeper than its rest depth + .02 per vertex (second ruling: the convex hull counts the under-jaw concavity as inside, so the hull depth is a report); the total overlap pair count is a report. Fable section 10 (2026-09-29): G3-head = (a) distal (q > .35 L) vs head BVH overlap 0 pairs + (b) SEAM VISIBILITY - of the whole-arm vs head overlap pairs none may be visible in the front / oblique 35 / side review cameras (head triangle facing the camera and the midpoint unoccluded by head/body), rest included; calibration: rest and 221c must score 0. Proximal signed depth, hull depth and the total pair count are reports. Rule (iii): the hand >= .5 visible from the front at every frame (rest ~.92). Director ruling 2026-09-29: G3-head (b) = seam non-regression vs 221c per view (authored.seamBaseline), not "= 0". Director ruling 2026-09-29 (G3 body, after the codex per-vertex fix): hard = per-vertex SIGNED depth of the distal arm (q/L > .35) vs the evaluated body core mesh (nearest face + normal sign, > 0 inside), allowance max(rest, 0) + .02, native only; the height/azimuth max-radius table counts the space under the belly bulge as inside (measured offline +.13..+.16 at the back hang), so its per-vertex excess is a report. Offline has no body mesh (walk205 neutral-geometry.npz holds vertices only): offline body depth is report-only, the native gate is authoritative.

swingKnots.why: Fixed position phases .35/.50/.60/.84/.95; duty changes swingShare only.

stanceCenterY.why: Contact centroid 0.062492081057470415H ahead of pivot; owner permitted 0.05–0.08H; rolling offset included.

hang.why: Fixed own phase 0.5; measured target centroid 0.107333333; subtract rolling/rotated offset -0.109766952; sole 0.04H; fold=sole-body(q).

preContact.why: Fixed own phase 0.95; measured target centroid -0.164458333; subtract rolling/rotated offset -0.035183578; sole 0.02H; fold=sole-body(q).

rollingContactRepair.why: Fix 0..35 degree rolling polynomial extrapolation during supported push. Exact rest-mesh contact-envelope integral; return to original swing by fold, leaving legacy configs unchanged.

legModel.why: Paw centroid arc about a body-owned virtual pivot at native hip X/Y, permitted vertical lift; thigh still attached to actual P178 root.

hipPendulum.why: Single smooth symmetric C1 bump r=cubic endpoint interpolant minus D*[4u(1-u)]^p. One dip, no radial pose knots; endpoint radii/derivatives come from no-slip stance. Joint search minimizes actual shortening. Rolling uses native clamped radians, geometric paw orientation uses true pitch. E2/E7 never relaxed.
